# paperclip_skill (Data Source)

Reads Paperclip skill details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "paperclip_skill" "task_lifecycle" {
  company_id = data.paperclip_company.acme.id
  name       = "paperclip-task-lifecycle"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (String) The Paperclip company ID.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Skill unique identifier.
- `name` (String) Skill name.
- `slug` (String) Skill slug.

### Read-Only

- `author_name` (String) Author display name.
- `categories` (List of String) Category tags.
- `color` (String) Skill UI badge color.
- `content` (String) Skill markdown content.
- `current_version_id` (String) Current active version snapshot ID.
- `description` (String) Skill description.
- `folder_id` (String) Folder ID.
- `forked_from_id` (String) Forked from skill ID.
- `homepage_url` (String) Homepage or documentation URL.
- `icon_url` (String) Skill icon URL.
- `key` (String) Canonical skill reference key.
- `metadata` (String) Skill JSON metadata.
- `schema_version` (Number) Skill schema version.
- `sharing_scope` (String) Sharing scope.
- `source_locator` (String) Provenance source locator.
- `source_type` (String) Provenance source type.
- `tagline` (String) Skill catalog tagline.
